risk_if_not_implemented: Without Security-Aware Design, security design weaknesses may be built into systems, increasing long-term vulnerability and the cost of remediation.

compensating_control_1.name: Secure Engineering Principles
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of industry-recognized security, compliance and resilience practices in the specification, design, development, implementation and modification of Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS).
compensating_control_1.justification: Secure Engineering Principles (SEA-01) provides secure engineering and architectural guidance that compensates for the absence of Security-Aware Design (SEA-01.5) by embedding security requirements into design processes as an alternative control mechanism. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Security, Compliance & Resilience In Project Management
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to assess security, compliance and resilience controls as part of Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) project development to determine whether controls are implemented correctly, operating as intended and producing the desired outcome with respect to meeting requirements.
compensating_control_2.justification: Security, Compliance & Resilience In Project Management (PRM-04) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Security-Aware Design (SEA-01.5) by ensuring the organization can restore operations when the primary control is absent. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
